BEYOND THE FLY-THRU

Spring drainage mapping for Glacier and Prairie Glen

The same aircraft that builds the fly-thru can map the golf courses. This work is measured and accuracy-checked, so the course team can count on the numbers when it plans drainage work and fairway/green fixes.

How ground shape causes wet turf

Runoff from the slope above drains into a shallow dip in the fairway that has no way out. The map measures the dip and shows where a drain can carry the water.

6-inch contours, 3-foot index lines
Low spots where water sits
Where surface water flows
A possible drain tile route
Aerial photo of a Devil’s Head hole (WI DNR imagery). The contours, low spot, and drain route are made up to show the idea; they are not measured data.
Low spots and ponding

Find where water sits on fairways, approaches, and greens, and how deep and wide each spot is.

Where water flows

Trace how runoff moves across each hole and where it gathers, to pin down the cause of soft or wet areas.

Drain tile and regrading plans

Plan drain tile routes and regrading from measured elevations instead of estimates.

Cut and fill volumes

Calculate the cubic yards to cut or bring in before a hole is fixed, reshaped, or rebuilt, so material can be priced first.

Before-and-after checks

Map an area before work starts and again after, to confirm the fix did what it was meant to.

Measured Drainage Mapping

THE FLEXIBLE CHOICE, RESERVED FOR THE PROBLEM HOLES. Priced by the acre and booked hole by hole, so there is no need to map a whole course. Ground control, checkpoints, and accuracy report included · $750 minimum ($1,000 list).

$60 / acre listFOUNDING PARTNER$45 / acre
Why the numbers can be relied on

Each mapping job is tied to ground control and checked against independent checkpoints measured on site with RTK GNSS. The accuracy results come with the data, so the course team knows how far it can trust each measurement.

Good to know

The drone measures open ground. Under tree canopy it can’t see the ground, so wooded areas are not measured.

Have a fairway or green that regularly holds water?

Novak|GS can start with that area before spring drainage or regrading work begins.
